# Packages the licence check tolerates: name  # reason
# Two kinds: AGPL/GPL packages, and packages whose licence the metadata does not identify (unknown or missing).
# The list may only shrink. An entry that no installed AGPL/GPL or unidentified package matches is stale and fails CI.

ultralytics-thop       # AGPL-3.0, scheduled for removal
